one_line_thought: 地図は、niche を薄くする。

axis_semantics.z_meaning: native GPS height above mean sea level on the same tracking event as x-y and timestamp
axis_semantics.claim_boundary: axis-resolved realized flight-state support conditional on the archived tracking design; not fundamental niche, occupancy, causal vertical preference, canopy height, or height above ground

z_discretization.rule: left_closed_right_open_except_last; negative and >=3200 m values remain in explicit tail bins; no clipping or winsorization
z_discretization.rationale: fixed physically interpretable multiplicative altitude bands anchored at sea level and 50 m; no empirical quantiles or outcome-adaptive cutpoints

numeric_qc.source_marked_outliers_sensitivity: exclude manually_marked_outlier only as a fixed sensitivity

whole_individual_split.algorithm: reuse exactly the structural split: sort identifiers by SHA256('odsp-n2-bat-v1|<individual>'); first ceil(0.25*n) sealed

support_weighting.model_pool: each model individual has equal total mass across all finite-height events in primary eligible cells; events within an individual share that mass equally
support_weighting.sealed_scoring: each sealed individual contributes one equal-weight mean log-score gain; event count does not weight one sealed individual more than another
support_weighting.reason: prevent tracking duration or event count from making one individual dominate niche thickness or answer-check

primary_estimand.support_state: S(x,y,z) on primary eligible 5 km model-pool cells and primary fixed z bins
primary_estimand.local_map: axis_thickness_map effective vertical states per supported primary x-y cell
primary_estimand.projection_interpretation: H(Z|X,Y) is the vertical-state information discarded when z is marginalized from the declared x-y-z support representation
primary_estimand.reason_no_magnitude_threshold: thickness is an estimand to report, not a post-hoc pass/fail effect-size cutoff

model_distribution.conditional: P_model(z|x,y) from equal-individual weighted model support in primary eligible cells
model_distribution.marginal_comparator: P_model(z) over the same eligible-cell model support, ignoring x-y
model_distribution.smoothing: Jeffreys additive pseudocount 0.5 per z bin for both conditional and marginal probabilities

sealed_answer_check.scored_events: finite-height sealed events whose x-y cell is primary-model eligible
sealed_answer_check.aggregate_metric: unweighted mean of the two sealed-individual mean gains
sealed_answer_check.uncertainty: do not report a pseudo-precise bootstrap CI from only two sealed individuals; report both individual gains and their equal-weight mean

decision_categories.estimable_and_generalizing: both sealed individuals meet scoring coverage and both individual mean log-score gains are > 0
decision_categories.estimable_but_generalization_mixed: coverage passes but sealed-individual gains are not sign-consistent
decision_categories.estimable_but_non_generalizing: coverage passes and both sealed-individual gains are <= 0
decision_categories.empirical_thickness_answer_check_unavail: finite-height fraction or sealed scoring coverage fails under frozen rules

secondary_reports.sealed_descriptive_H_Z_given_XY: may be reported under the same frozen bins/cells as descriptive replication, but cannot override the primary answer-check category
secondary_reports.grid_and_bin_sensitivities: report support/non-support/not_evaluable without promoting a sensitivity to primary

do_not_claim: height above ground or canopy-relative height
